info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Autopays-v4-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Autopay Listing API provides a mechanism for users to access details regarding existing autopay arrangements for utility bills. This endpoint allows developers to retrieve comprehensive lists of autopay entries, including relevant information and statuses. Typically utilized by finance and billing platforms, this API facilitates streamlined management of customer payment preferences and improves user experience. Integrating this API enables businesses to offer enhanced billing solutions, ensuring timely payments and increased customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the current status of the autopay feature for billing, providing insights into its configuration and active status.

requestBody.description: Request to retrieve the current autopay settings for the billing account. This request should include all necessary identifiers required to process the request.
